entities.name: UE in MR-DC
entities.description: UE operating in Multi-RAT Dual Connectivity configuration

entities.name: EN-DC condition
entities.description: UE considers itself in EN-DC if configured with nr-SecondaryCellGroupConfig according to TS 36.331 and connected to EPC

entities.name: NGEN-DC condition
entities.description: UE considers itself in NGEN-DC if configured with nr-SecondaryCellGroupConfig according to TS 36.331 and connected to 5GC

entities.name: NE-DC condition
entities.description: UE considers itself in NE-DC if configured with mrdc-SecondaryCellGroup set to eutra-SCG

entities.name: NR-DC condition
entities.description: UE considers itself in NR-DC if configured with mrdc-SecondaryCellGroup set to nr-SCG

entities.name: MR-DC condition
entities.description: UE considers itself in MR-DC if in (NG)EN-DC, NE-DC or NR-DC

entities.name: Subclause execution procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE to execute subclauses of clause 5 in TS 38.331

entities.name: Signaling Radio Bearer 3
entities.description: SRB3 used for SCG signaling in MR-DC

entities.name: Requirements in clause 5.1.2
entities.description: General requirements for UE behavior in TS 38.331 clause 5.1.2

relations.description: UE considers itself in EN-DC when the EN-DC condition is met
UE considers itself in NGEN-DC when the NGEN-DC condition is met
UE considers itself in NE-DC when the NE-DC condition is met
UE considers itself in NR-DC when the NR-DC condition is met
UE considers itself in MR-DC when any of the MR-DC conditions are met
Subclause execution applies to messages received on SRB3 when SRB3 is established
UE must follow requirements in clause 5.1.2 when executing subclauses
